_comment: Reference check: 3 images at the best point of Claude campaign 1 (amp 1 = HDU 2). Bounds are collapsed to one value so every image is taken there.

detector._comment: Row/col slices into the FITS image array [r0:r1, c0:c1].

objective._comment: F = min(|noise_overscan / gain|, max_baseline) + sum penalties.

penalties._comment: Uncomment to activate. Penalizes inverted gain.
Penalizes saturation / near-zero gain: max(0, 2*noise_os - noise_active).
Penalizes overscan charge level far from 0. Scale in ADU.

optimizer._comment: gp with only initial points = fixed-point measurements (the 'dummy' type does not run).

parameters._comment: Drain gate voltage. LTA command: lta set vdd <val>
parameters.name: Vdd

parameters._comment: Drain voltage. LTA command: lta set vdrain <val>
parameters.name: Vdrain

parameters._comment: Reset gate voltage. LTA command: lta set r <val>
parameters.name: Vr

parameters._comment: H-clock delay. LTA command: lta delay_H_overlap <val>
parameters.name: delay_H_overlap

parameters._comment: Horizontal clock HIGH level, all three phases (hh in voltage_skp_lta_v2.sh). Sets h1ah, h1bh, h2ch, h3ah, h3bh to the same value. Script default -2. Bounds keep the script's constraints th > hh > tl and hh > sh with th=-1, tl=-3.5, sh=-3.
parameters.name: hh

parameters._comment: Horizontal clock LOW level, all three phases (hl in voltage_skp_lta_v2.sh). Sets h1al, h1bl, h2cl, h3al, h3bl to the same value. Script default -4.5. Bounds keep the script's constraints tl > hl > sl and sh > hl with tl=-3.5, sl=-10, sh=-3.
parameters.name: hl

_examples_direct_and_timing._comment: Examples of 'direct' and 'timing' command types (not active params).
